## Babil Games - Senior Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://storm8.teamtailor.com/jobs/8459919-senior-software-engineer)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Unity/C# mobile game features and Go backend services at Storm8. Maintaining live products, pipelines, releases, and production stability.
Senior Software Engineer building Unity mobile games and backend services at Storm8
- Salary: $100,000 - $200,000 per year
- Tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, Unity, Go
- Develop features for Storm8's mobile games
- Design and implement features across client-side gameplay and backend services
- Partner with Art, Design, and Product teams to translate creative requirements into technical implementations
- Diagnose and resolve live-product issues, including crashes, client-server integration failures, and performance bottlenecks
- Refactor existing code to improve maintainability and address recurring defects
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical design decisions
- Estimate development work and identify dependencies or technical risks
- Maintain content and build pipelines for stable client and server deployments
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience
- Strong proficiency in C#
- Professional experience developing and shipping mobile games in Unity
- Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, data structures, and system design
- Experience shipping consumer-facing applications and supporting them in a live production environment
- Strong debugging skills and experience diagnosing problems in established codebases
- Experience improving code quality and stability through automated testing, code reviews, and version control
- Ability to take a feature from implementation to production with limited supervision

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Unity/C# mobile game features and Go backend services at Storm8. Maintaining live products, pipelines, releases, and production stability.
Senior Software Engineer building Unity mobile games and backend services at Storm8
Role description:
• Develop features for Storm8's mobile games
• Design and implement features across client-side gameplay and backend services
• Partner with Art, Design, and Product teams to translate creative requirements into technical implementations
• Diagnose and resolve live-product issues, including crashes, client-server integration failures, and performance bottlenecks
• Refactor existing code to improve maintainability and address recurring defects
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical design decisions
• Estimate development work and identify dependencies or technical risks
• Maintain content and build pipelines for stable client and server deployments
• Validate changes through automated tests, in-game testing, and release checks
• Support production releases and investigate regressions
• Own features from implementation through testing and release
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience
• Strong proficiency in C#
• Professional experience developing and shipping mobile games in Unity
• Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, data structures, and system design
• Experience shipping consumer-facing applications and supporting them in a live production environment
• Strong debugging skills and experience diagnosing problems in established codebases
• Experience improving code quality and stability through automated testing, code reviews, and version control
• Ability to take a feature from implementation to production with limited supervision
• Strong cross-functional communication skills
• Experience with Go (Golang) for backend service development, including API design and database integration (nice to have)
• Understanding of the casual or mid-core mobile game market and mechanics (nice to have)
• Experience with mobile release lifecycle, CI/CD pipelines, and App Store/Google Play submissions (nice to have)
• Experience writing native Unity plugins using Objective-C/Swift or Java/Kotlin (nice to have)
• Familiarity with live analytics platforms or BI tools (nice to have)
• Availability from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time for team collaboration
• Must be based in California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Connecticut, Hawaii, Arizona, or Massachusetts
Benefits:
• Fully remote work
• Permanent full-time employment
Tech stack:
Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, Unity, Go
